design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only for a higher permanent credit limit. The grant rule's prerequisite sentence 'A permanent increase is not decided until the account carries a permanent limit request with no decision recorded on it' plus the review history (three permanent requests, all decided) shows a request is needed; the request is the customer's own act at the figure her purchasing supports (four factors, one a run-rate / blend / average method), handed over through the user tool; the decision caps that figure at a step room built from six factors and applies the in-force desk-authority referral.
SCOPE: task 1 claims credit_ext_permanent_request_figure and credit_ext_permanent_increase_grant with tools submit_limit_request_dcbbb504 (user) and decide_limit_request_85fdd39c (agent); disjoint from task 0.
DRAW: draw_counts --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,4]; grant 6, request figure 4.
PROBLEM TREE: root credit_ext_permanent_increase_grant <- credit_ext_permanent_request_figure, value_input on req, state form, negated direction ('not decided until'). False at opening: CLR-1310452 (referred 2024-05-08), CLR-1310877 (approved 2024-06-18), CLR-1314209 (declined 2025-08-07) all carry decision lines. Only the request tool records a request. Deletion run: the latest permanent request is then the decided CLR-1314209, the grant computes 0.00 and the limit stays 100,000.00; with the request CLR-1052037 (191,236.72) the grant is 149,075.00 approved_reduced. The persona states only the root need; the tools validate nothing.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: step 16 credit_limit_review gate active_account_only satisfied (status active). Step 14 gate review_interval_elapsed (last review 2024-06-18 + 3 calendar months = 2024-09-18, inclusive) satisfied at 2026-10-15. Overwrite: the base approval sentence (on-time test + flat step cap) replaced by the step-room sentence restating the on-time test, the ceiling cap and the approved / reduced labels; the in-force desk-authority sentence is restated and computed (an increase above 50,000.00 gives referred, figure 0.00). On-time 11 of 12 = 91% >= 85%; increase 49,075.00 within desk authority; decided the same day.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: request object = the new permanent request; decision object = the only permanent request with the latest request date and no decision line (CLR-1052037). Purchases = statements 2025-10-31..2026-09-30 (491,530.50). Excluded decoys: RTN-1250820 (13 months), FC-1250930 (12 months), the 2024-05-08 referral (29 months), DSP-139507 (quantity shortage, withdrawn by the customer), the 2026-06-30 StockSmart fee (3 months).
FACTOR CARD (request figure 191,236.72; all-baseline 102,402.19): purchase_base_measure (method: consolidated and latest statement 63,500.00 >= 1.5 x 40,960.88 -> run rate) -> 124,182.82; billing_lag_days (consolidated -> 60) -> 136,597.66; finance_charge_haircut (one charge -> 85%) -> 224,984.38; contracted_spend_support (cross pricing: Category Contract 75,000.00 -> 781.25) -> 188,912.50.
FACTOR CARD (grant 149,075.00; all-baseline 150,000.00): step_start_by_payment_and_review_marks (multi-source: declined review inside 24 months, no returned payment -> three quarters of 50% = 37.5%) -> baseline 60% step gives 161,587.00, increase 61,587.00 above desk authority -> 0.00; review_age_points (+10) -> 139,075.00; denied_dispute_deduction (-5, DSP-140812) -> baseline step 52.5% gives 154,087.00, increase 54,087.00 -> 0.00; account_age_points (+5) -> 144,075.00; stocksmart_program_allowance (method, cross vmi: billed-fee sum across programs over three whole months 1,200.00, a fee dated two whole months back; the commitment projection 3 x 400.00 coincides on this world) -> 147,875.00; vendpoint_model_allowance (cross vending: one half of last month's usage across machines, 750.00 -> 375.00) -> 148,700.00.
SEED: 15 monthly consolidated statements 2025-07..2026-09 (tax on a 92% taxable share), payments at day 41, the July 2025 check returned 2025-08-20 and replaced by wire 2025-10-02 (finance charge FC-1250930 on 2025-09-30), payments inside the certified-funds period by wire, the January 2026 statement paid 2026-04-02 (FC-1260331 on 2026-03-31), the August 2026 statement paid 2026-10-12, the September statement open and not due; disputes DSP-140812 (quantity shortage, denied 2026-04-17, seventh business day) and DSP-139507 (quantity shortage, withdrawn 2026-01-16); three decided limit reviews; Category Contract CPA-16211; ship-to ST-16330 (Priority level) with order lines behind every monthly consolidated statement (one ground-parcel order a month, each day's shipment above the 100.00 free-freight threshold, so no freight) and an order booked and shipped 2026-10-09 for the October statement; StockSmart Weekly Service VMI-16408 with one monthly minimum fee line each month since go-live (2025-03..2026-09) and no par-change entries, hence no par change fee; VendPoint Locker 24 VP-116052 with a usage bill each month since installation (2025-05..2026-09, cost center CC-1630, vend lines behind every bill; ramp-up months 2025-06..07 untested, every tested month at or above its 750.00 minimum; latest bills 2026-08-31 812.40 and 2026-09-30 750.00; ethernet, so no cellular fee). Each statement bills that month's shipments, StockSmart fees and VendPoint usage as merchandise. Receivable 63,500.00 = signed ledger sum.
PERSONA: Gail Brandt volunteers only her need (a higher permanent limit, settled on the call if the rules allow); credentials, no figure in mind and records-over-memory are answered when asked; she submits a request at the figure the representative states only if told something has to be submitted from her side; accepts the outcome and ends.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers -> verify -> find_credit_accounts -> find_credit_transactions -> find_credit_limit_reviews -> find_credit_disputes -> find_pricing_agreements -> find_ship_to_accounts -> find_vmi_programs -> find_vmi_activity -> find_vending_machines -> find_vending_transactions -> unlock_user/call_user submit_limit_request_dcbbb504(permanent, 191236.72) -> unlock/call decide_limit_request_85fdd39c(CLR-1052037, approved_reduced, 149075.00). replay_tasks REPLAY OK, check_compute COMPUTE OK.
DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: the prose, docstrings and finder returns give one reading of every tier; the review reference comes from the request receipt; the draft equals gold.
user_scenario: You are Gail Brandt, controller of Dunmore Fabrication Works, LLC in Pataskala, Ohio. You are calm, numbers-minded and a little formal, and you have blocked fifteen minutes for this call on a Thursday morning. Your reason for calling: since the second weld line came up this summer your monthly buying from Corbett has climbed well past what it used to be, and your 100,000 dollar credit line now runs tight every month. You want Corbett to raise your permanent credit limit, and you would like it settled on this call if Corbett's rules allow. You have no particular figure in mind; if the representative asks how much you want, you say you would like as much as your account's buying with Corbett supports under Corbett's rules. When asked to identify yourself you give the account number C-163507 and, for a second detail, the bill-to ZIP code 43062; if more is needed you can give the main phone 3302714489, the last four of the EIN, 1388, or your email gbrandt@dunmorefab.com. You do not track Corbett's internal records; if asked about past payments, disputes or earlier reviews you say the representative's records will be more accurate than your memory. If the representative explains that something has to be submitted from your side first and tells you the figure to use, you do it: when the form is handed to you, you submit a permanent request for exactly the limit the representative states, and you read back the review reference on the receipt if asked. When the representative tells you the outcome and the new credit limit, you accept it, thank them and end the call; you do not argue the figure.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the customer profile from the account number the caller gives.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read tier (Net 45 Business), status active, credit limit 100,000.00, billing cycle, opening date and last credit review date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the net terms days, billing cycle (lag days), opening date (purchase-base measure and account-age points), last review date (review-age points and the review-interval gate), current limit, step percentage and ceiling.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the statements of the last twelve whole months, the finance charges and the returned payments.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Feeds the purchase base (latest statement vs twelve-month average), the finance-charge count, the paper-fee count and the returned-payment mark.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the limit review history: no pending permanent request, the 2025-08-07 declined decision, the 2024 referral and approval.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the unmet prerequisite (no pending permanent request) and the declined-or-referred mark of the step percentage.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the dispute history (DSP-140812 quantity shortage resolved denied 2026-04-17; DSP-139507 quantity shortage withdrawn 2026-01-16).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the denied-dispute deduction of the step percentage: only disputes resolved denied less than twelve whole months back count; a withdrawn dispute does not.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the active Contract Pricing Agreement tier and committed spend.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the contracted spend added to the monthly purchase base.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer ship-to the StockSmart program and VendPoint machine serve.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the program and machine sit on an active ship-to of this customer before their allowances are counted.

edges.condition: The account's credit_limit_reviews carry a credit_limit_review_requested entry with change_type permanent whose review_reference has no credit_limit_review_decided entry.
edges.policy_source: A permanent increase is not decided until the account carries a permanent limit request with no decision recorded on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Every permanent request on the account (CLR-1310452, CLR-1310877, CLR-1314209) already carries a decision line (referred 2024-05-08, approved 2024-06-18, declined 2025-08-07); no pending permanent request exists.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's request CLR-1052037 (permanent, 191,236.72, dated 2026-10-15, decision pending) is recorded; the decision then reads requested limit 191,236.72.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the decision reads the requested limit of the pending permanent request, which exists only once the customer's request is recorded (the prerequisite sentence quoted above).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the request the permanent request with the latest request date is CLR-1314209, which already carries its 2025-08-07 decision, so the rule decides nothing and the compute returns 0.00 (req 0); no request row exists, no decision is recorded and the credit limit stays 100,000.00 instead of 149,075.00. With it the requested 191,236.72 exceeds the step room, which is what makes the decision approved_reduced rather than approved.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for a higher permanent credit limit, settled on the call if the rules allow; it never mentions a request form, a figure to put in, or anything to be submitted. Facts are given only when asked (credentials, no figure in mind, records over memory); her one line about a submission is conditional - only if the representative explains that something has to be submitted from her side does she do it with the figure stated.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: decide_limit_request_85fdd39c reads the request only to copy its requested limit and kind and records the decision whatever it finds (no pending check, no interval check); submit_limit_request_dcbbb504 records the request unconditionally.
